# Ishaan Dalvi

> 14-year-old systems builder and AI developer in Pune, Maharashtra, India. Engineering autonomous AI agents, sub-30ms edge infrastructure, and IoT microcontrollers on a ₹0 recurring cloud budget.

## Core Projects
- [Smart IoT Ant Habitat](https://github.com/ishaandalvi): Microcontroller (ESP32) environment tracking microclimates and regulating automated hydration for ant colonies.
- [India Road Tax Engine](https://github.com/ishaandalvi): Zero-lag client-side tax computation engine tested with security audits.
- [Autonomous Media Agent](https://github.com/ishaandalvi): Headless browser automation that formats, schedules, and dispatches media pipelines hands-free.
- [SkillClaw Fast Proxy](https://github.com/ishaandalvi): Cloudflare Workers edge network proxy delivering sub-28ms responses worldwide.
- [Heavy Video Processing Engine](https://github.com/ishaandalvi): Distributed FFmpeg worker queue with Redis BullMQ and cloud object storage.
- [Cyber Portfolio](https://ishaan-dalvi.pages.dev/): Handcrafted pure HTML/CSS/JS with zero runtime bloat and 100% Lighthouse compliance.
